Adani Power to invest Rs 48,000 crore in Assam project

Adani Power Limited announced an investment of Rs 48,000 crore for a power project in Assam. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma stated the project would be instrumental in transforming the state and would lead to a reduction in the average cost of power. The project is expected to play a major role in Assam's development.
